With „parkima” and a destination blocked by a vehicle, Estonian uses the illative „ette”, not the adessive „ees”.

For inserting an image into a document, „lisa” is the natural Estonian verb; „sisesta” implies data entry.
A sentence inserted into text is „lause teksti lisama”, not normally „lause teksti sisestama”.
